init_workspace_manager: init the workspace manager with a torch device and optional number of ubatches for GPU memory allocation
lock_workspace: lock the workspace to prevent further memory growth during model execution
unlock_workspace: unlock the workspace to allow memory growth during elastic expert parallelism scaling
get_simultaneous: get multiple workspace tensor views from a single pre-allocated buffer using shape and dtype tuples
reset_workspace_manager: reset the workspace manager to uninitialized state for clean test reinitialization
